query: For each supplied case, apply the frozen WIPO Overview 3.0 to attributed party contentions and recorded facts, and return a singleton list containing RELIEF_GRANTED or DENIED. Missing support is not a denial: ABSTAIN with null value and a reason when unable to complete. These are retrospective pre-analysis case extracts, not original filings. This query is registered for inspection: residual answer leakage and external-fact gaps remain, so it is not an evaluation-ready prediction benchmark.
note: INSPECTION_ONLY_LEAKAGE_AND_FACT_GAPS；本地派生任务，非原benchmark官方查询；没有模型执行或K测量。正式命令的规则抽取标签；保留正式原文，非新独立人工复核标签
